params.caption: 🕹️ EU's new law takes aim at pay-to-win games and influencer ads A new European Union law could change how pay-to-win items in games and influencer advertising work. The focus is on content and offers aimed at minors, which could force publishers to rethink in-game monetization in Europe. 🕒 Nov 19, 2026 · 14:55 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Dexerto ⚖️ React 👍 if it's about time · 💬 Should pay-to-win be banned outright? #PayToWin #EU #Microtransactions #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
